notes: stumbling block heads on stumbling as the meaning-bearing element under rule 66's generic-completion arm; heading on block remains defensible if block is read as a gloss of the lexeme rather than a completion.

The two substantival articles take the things under rules 22 and 102, and each inner genitive article is unrepresented for want of a determiner — the very construction rule 57 settles as τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ → the things of God.
τῷ before Πέτρῳ is unrepresented and unto rides with the name, no determiner standing (rules 21, 23).
